verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item specifies concrete CPU or wall-clock execution time limits for functions (e.g., seconds per plan tier). Docs mention Fluid compute, sandboxes, and workflows but never state numeric duration/CPU limits a devops-lead could use to size agentic workloads. Missing for 10: explicit maxDuration/timeout numbers per plan, CPU allocation limits, and any pricing-page or docs citation stating these limits.
